title.text: Turnstile — The Foundry Hall (invented venue, fixture data)

rules.text:
Polish pass inside docs/DESIGN_SYSTEM.md — no new tokens.

• Colours, type and spacing are turnstile.css values, light scheme shown.
• Every outcome: word, then glyph, then colour.
• Counts carry their rule ("87 remaining · 0 available — pool sold out").
• Figures are the frozen fixture's end state (expected_inventory.csv, expected_summary.json). Seat-by-seat balcony layouts and waitlist positions are sample states, labelled on the board.
